configurePresets.name: _ninja
configurePresets.description: Sacrosanct 3.1 s21.2: 'Ninja performs builds.' This is the conforming generator.

configurePresets.name: _make
configurePresets.description: NON-CONFORMING workstation fallback. Sacrosanct s21.2 mandates Ninja; this variant exists only because ninja is not installed on every workstation yet. Use it to prove a configure, never to publish a build number.

configurePresets.name: macos-arm64-release
configurePresets.description: The conforming release configure: Ninja, FORGE_NETWORK=OFF, dependencies resolved through the lock.

configurePresets.name: macos-arm64-release-offline
configurePresets.description: As macos-arm64-release, but FORGE_DEPS_STRICT=ON: a dependency that falls back to the machine-global Homebrew prefix FAILS the configure instead of warning. This is the preset CI must prove.

configurePresets.name: macos-arm64-release-make
configurePresets.displayName: macOS arm64 — Release (Unix Makefiles fallback, offline)
configurePresets.description: FALLBACK. Identical cache to macos-arm64-release except the generator. Exists because ninja is absent on this workstation; see toolchain.generator_fallback in deps.lock.json.

configurePresets.name: macos-arm64-release-make-strict
configurePresets.displayName: macOS arm64 — Release, Makefiles fallback, offline + strict

configurePresets.name: macos-arm64-ship
configurePresets.displayName: macOS arm64 — native SHIPPING kernel core (no Node, offline)
configurePresets.description: The kernel half of the shipping build of the native app (forge-desktop preset of the same name links its forge_kernel_core). Every option that decides what ships is PINNED here rather than inherited from a CMakeLists default: FORGE_BUILD_NODE_ADDON defaults ON, and every other preset in this file inherits that default, which is why their forge_all builds forge-kernel.node and why they run `node` at configure time. This preset runs no node, needs no node_modules, and builds no addon. Generator: Unix Makefiles, because it is present on every Mac with the command line tools and ninja is not installed on this workstation; the generator changes no compile flag. Gate: forge-desktop/test/native_ship_gate.sh.

configurePresets.name: macos-arm64-online-seed
configurePresets.description: The only preset in which a configure-time fetch is legal. It exists to populate .forge-local/sources; a release is never built from it.

buildPresets.name: macos-arm64-ship
buildPresets.description: Only what the shipped app links: the node-free kernel core. Not forge_all -- that aggregate means 'whatever this configure enabled', and a shipping build should name what it ships.

buildPresets.name: macos-arm64-release-clean
buildPresets.description: The clean workflow (s21.2). The warm workflow is the plain build preset.

workflowPresets.name: macos-arm64-release
workflowPresets.description: Configure -> clean build -> test, all offline.
